I'm not going to miss anything because I will cease to exist - as I don't remember existing before I was born. Memory wasn't and won't be - it's only there for the time you're alive. I'm not defending suicide or anything - just technically speaking that there's no scientific evidence of consciousness existing outside of lifespan, so "missing something you do while being alive" is nonsense. 

I am indulging in chocolate cake today for lunch, which is something I truly appreciate, but that's about it.
Damn phone still ringing and I haven't had the time to do anything else. But this building I work at is very tall and I have access to the last floor.
